text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pulled by the hand by Matikanefukukitaru,
I was brought somewhere. This place is...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Come on Trainer-san, it's mountain climbing time, mountain climbing!
Charging up the mountain, swift as the... mountain itself~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, the truth is,
I happened to hear a certain rumor.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Supposedly, if you call a certain phone number
from a spiritual spot, you'll receive
good luck power...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So, the plan is to climb this mountain, renowned as a sacred peak,
and try calling from the top!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's go!
Over the rocks and roots we go—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The climb began. But what they were stepping over
was neither rocks nor roots.

text_block_list.name: Mononoke
text_block_list.text:
Kekekeke, here they come, here they come!
I won't let you leave alive!

text_block_list.name: Departed Soul
text_block_list.text: Heeeelp me, heeeelp me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Pushing through the horrifying wails of resentment.
In a different sense, this place truly feels like a sacred mountain of spirits."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Trainer, you look pale.
What's wrong? Are you out of breath?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Can't hear it, you say... Ah, the birds chirping?
I hear it, they're tweeting so adorably, aren't they?
choice_data_list: You don't have any spiritual sense or anything?
You don't have any psychic sense or anything?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Spiritual awareness?
Hmm, maybe I have it, maybe I don't...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, the details don't matter!
Let's just keep things rough and loose!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite believing in the occult this much,
she seems to have zero sixth sense. And—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Phew, I suppose around here will do.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Then without further ado, let's call
that rumored lucky number...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
W-What?!
A call came in before I could even dial?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trainer, could it be that my lucky number jumped right at us?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, I guess I really should answer it?
There's no way an unlucky call would come through on a lucky mountain, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Not necessarily. Judging by how things looked along the way...
This calls for some serious thought."
choice_data_list: Why not give it a shot?
Maybe it's better not to enter...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Fufufu, Lucky Number-san
is like a moth flying into a flame~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hello, is this Lucky?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "No. It is Taiki Shuttle!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Taiki-san... It was an unknown number, so
I didn't realize it was you. Are you at a payphone?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'm trying to call
a phone number that'll bring me happiness, you see.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"A number that can make you happy...?
What's that? Could it be...?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "Isn't it the other way around? They say there are cursed numbers where, if you call them, you get cursed. ...Heheh."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A curse...?
Wait, no way... Did I mishear?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: E-E-E-Excuse me, Taiki-san!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trainer, is this...
choice_data_list: Looks like I made a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wahhhhh!
I'm really bad with curses~. Save me~~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru dashed down the mountain with a momentum
that would make even Hakone Ekiden runners turn pale.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru, Trainer-san.
Huh? Were you two going somewhere, DESUKA?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Where, you ask...? We just talked about it.
On the phone.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Man, Taiki-san,
thank you so much for teaching me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If you hadn't told me that was a cursed phone number, Taiki-san,
I would have accidentally called it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, earlier? A phone call?
I didn't make any phone calls, no way!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about~?
Just a moment ago from the payphone...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Why use a payphone when you have a smartphone...
Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wonder who was on the other end of that call?
Still, running all over the mountain turned out to be great exercise.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh, why is that?
There's no reason not to enter...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh? That sound just now was...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh, my phone screen is cracked...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, talk about bad luck~
I've got a bad feeling about this..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Could this...
C-C-Could this possibly be!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained that I had seen
a lot of bad things along the way.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyobobo! I didn't notice at all~!
Eeeeek, save me~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru bolted down the mountain at full speed.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I asked Taiki about it
after that, and...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Turns out that phone number wasn't a lucky number, but a cursed one.
choice_data_list: Did your phone take the hit for you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It seems so.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, thank you, smartphone. Rest in peace.
And now...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hurry back from the repair shop.
I'm lost without you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...She decided to act like the curse never happened and just kept using it.
